summary.intent: Take the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge (Soony launch) from reading the briefs to a hosted, demo-ready product (Lighthouse): analyze supplier/ERP data, build a polling+agent pipeline that detects launch risks and acts, and prepare the demo, interview and hand-in by 12:45.
summary.outcome: Found that the Collector's Edition misses Sunday (art book overbooking, failed statues, etc.), built and shipped Lighthouse (poller, reader/verifier, decision cards, routines, role split, Maren approval path), and moved the open demo at lighthouse.stenglein.dev from the Mac to ada with real SMTP sending and reply polling being enabled. Main is pushed through 0863dd3 plus Lucas's README commit; several later commits (bf486bb, cf6a9ed, e2d9098, c26558b, 3cc06c8) are local only; no demo video was produced.

repo: Portal API has only GET /api/v1/files, /files/{path}, /archive.zip; no webhooks/notifications. Files change without warning (also replaced under same name), so poll the file list and compare SHA-256.
data/ (portal data, scans, notes) and .env are gitignored; challenge data is confidential and must never be hardcoded or put in code.
scripts/demo.sh has restart, story and save-story modes; ASK_DEMO_OPEN=on and ASK_DEMO_HOST=lighthouse.stenglein.dev select open demo mode; ASK_DEMO_MAIL=real turns on real SMTP and ASK_REPLY_POLL.
Demo server env flags: ASK_MAIL_DRY (on = emails only recorded), ASK_CALL_PROVIDER=dry_run, ASK_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD empty = no login, ASK_REPLY_POLL for reading supplier replies.

Hosted demo copy lives on ada at ~/Jonas/StartMunichHack/lighthouse-host (tmux sessions ask-soony-demo and lighthouse-tunnel, tunnel lighthouse-ada); it is a snapshot, so code changes need rsync/build copy plus restart.
Team workflow files CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md exist in the repo; Entire hooks only create checkpoints when repo files change, and push checkpoint refs on git push.

Real data quirks: SAP booked 80,000 art books vs 8,000 on the scanned delivery note; 5,600 failed-inspection statues booked unrestricted; sleeve artwork rev B (PackRight) vs rev C (Nowak); lid magnet shortage is a false alarm since PackRight fits them.
workflow: `cloudflared tunnel info` can report an old inactive tunnel; a traced request with a unique marker checked against each machine's server log is the reliable way to see where a hostname is served from.

Restarting a cloudflared tunnel takes all hosts on it down briefly; a second connector of the same tunnel splits traffic across machines, so a new tunnel plus a DNS repoint is the safe migration path.
Compare secrets across machines by checksum, not by printing values; do not build mid-recording because the recorder reloads pages.
Do not push when the user says so; keep changes as local commits and report how many commits main is ahead.

friction: tmux session name mismatch during the tunnel restart took all three hostnames down (530) for about a minute.
The first recorder script wrote frames only at the end, so stopping it early produced no video.
Resetting the demo repeatedly was needed because tests (e.g. the Maren path) left the art books case sent.
A false 'lost column' warning on Launch from a misread legacy CSV header had to be fixed in the data check.
Stale 'Passed on' Done screen survived role switches, and Maren's request showed only as a tiny row.
Push rejected because Lucas pushed a README commit in the meantime (resolved by fast-forward).
Another chat made conflicting commits and gave a different answer about where the demo is hosted.
Demo with real mail and no login means anyone with the link can email suppliers; the duplicate guard is weaker on the demo.
